name: zrndr_span_occlusion_test_point_visibility
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::TestPointVisibility stages one projected point as a one-pixel span and tests the matching occlusion column.
known_limits: VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x498c40 validates staging samplePoint->z into invDepth and invDepthStep, clearing depthSlope, truncating samplePoint->x into sampleXMin/sampleXMax through _ftol, truncating samplePoint->y into the column index, passing a stack out-status to zRndr_SpanOcclusion::TestColumnVisibility, and returning one only for a positive visibility status.
The native point-visibility smoke verifies one-pixel span staging from fractional projected coordinates and both visible and occluded column outcomes.
